newsitem.title: UK: Friends Provident 1996 single premium sales shine.
newsitem.headline: Friends Provident 1996 single premium sales shine.

text.p: Friends Provident, the British mutual insurance group, said on Tuesday its new business figures for 1996 showed total income more than doubled to 1.23 billion stg from 579 million stg in the year-ago period.
Its total new single premium business formed a substantial part of this rise, jumping to 625 million stg from 371 million, Friends Provident said in a statement.
Within this it said single premium individual life business nearly trebled, rising to 301 million stg from 112 million stg "as a result of excellent bond sales".

Another highlight was the performance of the company's asset management subsidiary which attracted third party investments from institutions of 520 million stg, up on the previous year's 123 million stg.
Group chief executive Michael Doerr said the company's total funds under management had grown to 18 billion stg.
